items.question: Trong câu "A host is any device connected to a network that has an IP address — a computer, phone, server, router, and so on.", từ "host" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A host is any device connected to a network that has an IP address — a computer, phone, server, router, and so on.", what does "host" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: host /həʊst/ (danh từ): thiết bị trong mạng (có IP). Trong mạng máy tính, "host" là thiết bị có IP; nghĩa đời thường: chủ nhà, người dẫn chương trình.
items.explanationEn: host /həʊst/ (noun): a device on a network. In networking, a host is any device with an IP; everyday senses are a person receiving guests or a show presenter.

items.question: Trong câu "A host is any device connected to a network that has an IP address — a computer, phone, server, router, and so on.", từ "device" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A host is any device connected to a network that has an IP address — a computer, phone, server, router, and so on.", what does "device" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: device /dɪˈvaɪs/ (danh từ): thiết bị. "Device" = thiết bị (máy tính, điện thoại); nghĩa khác ít gặp: mưu mẹo, thủ thuật.
items.explanationEn: device /dɪˈvaɪs/ (noun): a piece of equipment. A device is equipment such as a computer or phone; a rarer sense is a trick or method.

items.question: Trong câu "A host is any device connected to a network that has an IP address — a computer, phone, server, router, and so on.", từ "connect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A host is any device connected to a network that has an IP address — a computer, phone, server, router, and so on.", what does "connect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: connect /kəˈnekt/ (động từ): kết nối. "Be connected to a network" = được kết nối vào mạng; danh từ: connection.
items.explanationEn: connect /kəˈnekt/ (verb): to join or link. "Be connected to a network" means linked to it; noun: connection.

items.question: Trong câu "A host is any device connected to a network that has an IP address — a computer, phone, server, router, and so on.", từ "and so on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A host is any device connected to a network that has an IP address — a computer, phone, server, router, and so on.", what does "and so on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: and so on /ənd ˈsəʊ ɒn/ (cụm từ): vân vân. "And so on" = vân vân, đặt cuối danh sách; đồng nghĩa: etc.
items.explanationEn: and so on /ənd ˈsəʊ ɒn/ (phrase): and other similar things. "And so on" ends a list of examples; it means the same as etc.

items.question: Trong câu "The term "host" simply refers to a device participating in the network.", từ "term" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The term "host" simply refers to a device participating in the network.", what does "term" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a word with a set meaning
items.explanation: term /tɜːm/ (danh từ): thuật ngữ. "The term X" = thuật ngữ X; nghĩa khác: học kỳ, điều khoản (terms and conditions).
items.explanationEn: term /tɜːm/ (noun): a word with a set meaning. "The term X" is a word used with a set meaning; other senses: semester, contract terms.

items.question: Trong câu "The term "host" simply refers to a device participating in the network.", từ "simply" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The term "host" simply refers to a device participating in the network.", what does "simply" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: simply /ˈsɪm.pli/ (trạng từ): chỉ đơn giản là. "Simply refers to" = đơn giản chỉ là; dùng để nhấn mạnh ý không có gì phức tạp.
items.explanationEn: simply /ˈsɪm.pli/ (adverb): just, merely. "Simply refers to" means it just means that; it stresses there is nothing more to it.

items.question: Trong câu "The term "host" simply refers to a device participating in the network.", từ "refer to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The term "host" simply refers to a device participating in the network.", what does "refer to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: refer to /rɪˈfɜː tuː/ (cụm từ): dùng để chỉ. "X refers to Y" = X dùng để chỉ Y; nghĩa khác: tra cứu (refer to the docs).
items.explanationEn: refer to /rɪˈfɜː tuː/ (phrase): to mean or describe. "X refers to Y" means X is the name for Y; another sense is consult (refer to the docs).

items.question: Trong câu "The term "host" simply refers to a device participating in the network.", từ "participate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The term "host" simply refers to a device participating in the network.", what does "participate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: participate /pɑːˈtɪs.ɪ.peɪt/ (động từ): tham gia. "Participate in X" = tham gia vào X; đồng nghĩa: take part in.
items.explanationEn: participate /pɑːˈtɪs.ɪ.peɪt/ (verb): to take part. "Participate in X" means take part in X.

items.question: Trong câu "Most Internet applications operate on the Client–Server model:", từ "operate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most Internet applications operate on the Client–Server model:", what does "operate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: operate /ˈɒp.ər.eɪt/ (động từ): hoạt động, vận hành. "Operate on a model" = hoạt động theo mô hình; nghĩa khác: phẫu thuật (operate on a patient).
items.explanationEn: operate /ˈɒp.ər.eɪt/ (verb): to work or function. "Operate on a model" means work according to it; another sense is surgery (operate on a patient).

items.question: Trong câu "Most Internet applications operate on the Client–Server model:", từ "model" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most Internet applications operate on the Client–Server model:", what does "model" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a pattern of how things work
items.explanation: model /ˈmɒd.əl/ (danh từ): mô hình (cách tổ chức). "Client–Server model" = mô hình khách–chủ; nghĩa khác: người mẫu, đời máy (a new phone model).
items.explanationEn: model /ˈmɒd.əl/ (noun): a pattern of how things work. "Client–Server model" is a pattern of working; other senses: a fashion model or a product version.

items.question: Trong câu "Server: a dedicated computer that receives and processes the request, and returns data (the response).", từ "dedicated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Server: a dedicated computer that receives and processes the request, and returns data (the response).", what does "dedicated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: dedicated /ˈded.ɪ.keɪ.tɪd/ (tính từ): chuyên dụng, dành riêng. "Dedicated server" = máy chủ dành riêng; nghĩa khác: tận tụy (a dedicated teacher).
items.explanationEn: dedicated /ˈded.ɪ.keɪ.tɪd/ (adjective): used for one purpose only. "Dedicated server" is used only for one job; another sense is committed (a dedicated teacher).

items.question: Trong câu "Server: a dedicated computer that receives and processes the request, and returns data (the response).", từ "process" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Server: a dedicated computer that receives and processes the request, and returns data (the response).", what does "process" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: process /ˈprəʊ.ses/ (động từ): xử lý (dữ liệu, yêu cầu). "Process the request" = xử lý yêu cầu; danh từ: process (quy trình, tiến trình).
items.explanationEn: process /ˈprəʊ.ses/ (verb): to deal with data. "Process the request" means handle it; as a noun, process means a procedure.

items.question: Trong câu "Server: a dedicated computer that receives and processes the request, and returns data (the response).", từ "response" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Server: a dedicated computer that receives and processes the request, and returns data (the response).", what does "response" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: response /rɪˈspɒns/ (danh từ): phản hồi. "Request–response" = yêu cầu–phản hồi; động từ: respond; đừng nhầm với responsibility.
items.explanationEn: response /rɪˈspɒns/ (noun): a reply. "Request–response" is the basic pair; verb: respond; do not confuse with responsibility.

items.question: Trong câu "You place an order on Shopee → the app (client) sends a request to Shopee's server → the server processes the order.", từ "place an order" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You place an order on Shopee → the app (client) sends a request to Shopee's server → the server processes the order.", what does "place an order" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: place an order /pleɪs ən ˈɔː.dər/ (cụm từ): đặt hàng. "Place an order" = đặt hàng; "order" còn nghĩa là thứ tự (in order) hoặc mệnh lệnh.
items.explanationEn: place an order /pleɪs ən ˈɔː.dər/ (phrase): to request to buy. "Place an order" means ask to buy; order can also mean sequence or command.

items.question: Trong câu "Most Internet applications operate on the Client–Server model:", từ "application" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most Internet applications operate on the Client–Server model:", what does "application" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: application /ˌæp.lɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): ứng dụng (phần mềm). "Internet applications" = ứng dụng Internet; nghĩa khác: đơn xin (job application).
items.explanationEn: application /ˌæp.lɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a software program. "Internet applications" are programs that use the network; another sense is a job application.

items.question: Trong câu "Server: a dedicated computer that receives and processes the request, and returns data (the response).", từ "receive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Server: a dedicated computer that receives and processes the request, and returns data (the response).", what does "receive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: receive /rɪˈsiːv/ (động từ): nhận. "Receive a request" = nhận yêu cầu; danh từ: receiver, receipt (biên lai).
items.explanationEn: receive /rɪˈsiːv/ (verb): to get something sent. "Receive a request" means get it; nouns: receiver, receipt.

items.question: Trong câu "This lets them test the application without deploying it to the Internet.", từ "test" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This lets them test the application without deploying it to the Internet.", what does "test" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: test /test/ (động từ): kiểm thử. "Test the application" = kiểm thử ứng dụng trước khi đưa lên thật; danh từ: test, tester.
items.explanationEn: test /test/ (verb): to check that it works. "Test the application" means check it works before release; nouns: test, tester.

items.question: Trong câu "Serves web pages (HTML, CSS, JS)", từ "serve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Serves web pages (HTML, CSS, JS)", what does "serve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: serve /sɜːv/ (động từ): cung cấp, trả về (cho client). Web server "serves web pages" = gửi trang web cho người dùng; nghĩa khác: phục vụ, phát bóng.
items.explanationEn: serve /sɜːv/ (verb): to deliver to users. A web server serves pages by delivering them to users; other senses: wait at tables, start a tennis point.

items.question: Trong câu "Handles business logic", từ "handle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Handles business logic", what does "handle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: handle /ˈhæn.dəl/ (động từ): xử lý. "Handle X" = xử lý X; danh từ "handle" = tay cầm; hay gặp: error handling.
items.explanationEn: handle /ˈhæn.dəl/ (verb): to deal with. "Handle X" means deal with X; as a noun, a handle is what you hold; see error handling.

items.question: Trong câu "Handles business logic", từ "logic" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Handles business logic", what does "logic" (noun) mean?
options: các quy tắc xử lý (của hệ thống)
items.explanation: logic /ˈlɒdʒ.ɪk/ (danh từ): các quy tắc xử lý (của hệ thống). "Business logic" = logic nghiệp vụ, các quy tắc xử lý của ứng dụng; nghĩa khác: môn logic học.
items.explanationEn: logic /ˈlɒdʒ.ɪk/ (noun): the rules a system follows. "Business logic" is the rule set an app follows; another sense is the study of reasoning.

items.question: Trong câu "Stores and queries data", từ "query" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stores and queries data", what does "query" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: query /ˈkwɪə.ri/ (động từ): truy vấn. "Query data" = truy vấn dữ liệu; nghĩa khác: đặt nghi vấn (query a decision).
items.explanationEn: query /ˈkwɪə.ri/ (verb): to request data from. "Query data" means ask a database for data; another sense is to question or doubt.

items.question: Trong câu "In practice, a single physical machine can run multiple types of server software at once.", từ "in practice" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In practice, a single physical machine can run multiple types of server software at once.", what does "in practice" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in practice /ɪn ˈpræk.tɪs/ (cụm từ): trên thực tế. "In practice" = trên thực tế, đối lập với "in theory"; "practice" còn nghĩa là luyện tập.
items.explanationEn: in practice /ɪn ˈpræk.tɪs/ (phrase): in reality. "In practice" means in reality, the opposite of "in theory"; practice also means training.

items.question: Trong câu "In practice, a single physical machine can run multiple types of server software at once.", từ "single" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In practice, a single physical machine can run multiple types of server software at once.", what does "single" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: single /ˈsɪŋ.ɡəl/ (tính từ): đơn lẻ, chỉ một. "A single machine" = chỉ một máy; nghĩa khác: độc thân; hay gặp: single point of failure.
items.explanationEn: single /ˈsɪŋ.ɡəl/ (adjective): only one. "A single machine" means just one; another sense is unmarried; see single point of failure.

items.question: Trong câu "In practice, a single physical machine can run multiple types of server software at once.", từ "physical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In practice, a single physical machine can run multiple types of server software at once.", what does "physical" (adjective) mean?
options: vật lý, hữu hình (phần cứng thật)
items.explanation: physical /ˈfɪz.ɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): vật lý, hữu hình (phần cứng thật). "Physical machine" = máy thật, đối lập với virtual; nghĩa khác: thể chất (physical exercise).
items.explanationEn: physical /ˈfɪz.ɪ.kəl/ (adjective): real and touchable. "Physical machine" is real hardware, not virtual; another sense relates to the body.

items.question: Trong câu "In practice, a single physical machine can run multiple types of server software at once.", từ "multiple" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In practice, a single physical machine can run multiple types of server software at once.", what does "multiple" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: multiple /ˈmʌl.tɪ.pəl/ (tính từ): nhiều. "Multiple types" = nhiều loại; hay gặp: multiple choice (trắc nghiệm).
items.explanationEn: multiple /ˈmʌl.tɪ.pəl/ (adjective): more than one. "Multiple types" means several kinds; see also multiple choice.

items.question: Trong câu "In practice, a single physical machine can run multiple types of server software at once.", từ "at once" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In practice, a single physical machine can run multiple types of server software at once.", what does "at once" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at once /ət ˈwʌns/ (cụm từ): cùng một lúc. "At once" ở đây = cùng lúc (simultaneously); nghĩa khác: ngay lập tức (come at once).
items.explanationEn: at once /ət ˈwʌns/ (phrase): at the same time. "At once" here means simultaneously; another sense is immediately (come at once).

items.question: Trong câu "Localhost is a special name that points back to the very computer you are using, equivalent to the IP address 127.0.0.1.", từ "point back" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Localhost is a special name that points back to the very computer you are using, equivalent to the IP address 127.0.0.1.", what does "point back" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: point back /pɔɪnt ˈbæk/ (cụm từ): trỏ ngược lại. "Point back to X" = trỏ ngược về X; localhost trỏ về chính máy bạn đang dùng.
items.explanationEn: point back /pɔɪnt ˈbæk/ (phrase): to refer back to. "Point back to X" means refer back to X; localhost refers to your own machine.

items.question: Trong câu "Localhost is a special name that points back to the very computer you are using, equivalent to the IP address 127.0.0.1.", từ "equivalent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Localhost is a special name that points back to the very computer you are using, equivalent to the IP address 127.0.0.1.", what does "equivalent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: equivalent /ɪˈkwɪv.əl.ənt/ (tính từ): tương đương. "Equivalent to X" = tương đương với X; danh từ: equivalence.
items.explanationEn: equivalent /ɪˈkwɪv.əl.ənt/ (adjective): equal in meaning. "Equivalent to X" means the same as X in value; noun: equivalence.

items.question: Trong câu "When developers build web applications, they run a server right on their personal machine and access it via:", từ "personal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When developers build web applications, they run a server right on their personal machine and access it via:", what does "personal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: personal /ˈpɜː.sən.əl/ (tính từ): cá nhân. "Personal machine" = máy tính cá nhân; hay gặp: personal data (dữ liệu cá nhân).
items.explanationEn: personal /ˈpɜː.sən.əl/ (adjective): belonging to one person. "Personal machine" is your own computer; see also personal data.

items.question: Trong câu "When developers build web applications, they run a server right on their personal machine and access it via:", từ "via" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When developers build web applications, they run a server right on their personal machine and access it via:", what does "via" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: via /ˈvaɪ.ə/ (giới từ): thông qua. "Access it via X" = truy cập thông qua X; đồng nghĩa: through, by means of.
items.explanationEn: via /ˈvaɪ.ə/ (preposition): by way of. "Access it via X" means through X; synonyms: through, by means of.

items.question: Trong câu "This lets them test the application without deploying it to the Internet.", từ "deploy" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This lets them test the application without deploying it to the Internet.", what does "deploy" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: deploy /dɪˈplɔɪ/ (động từ): triển khai (đưa lên chạy thật). "Deploy an app" = triển khai ứng dụng lên môi trường thật; nghĩa gốc: điều quân; danh từ: deployment.
items.explanationEn: deploy /dɪˈplɔɪ/ (verb): to release for real use. "Deploy an app" means release it to run for real; the original sense is sending troops; noun: deployment.

items.question: Trong câu "Every host in a network has a unique IP address:", từ "unique" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every host in a network has a unique IP address:", what does "unique" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unique /juːˈniːk/ (tính từ): duy nhất, không trùng. "A unique IP" = IP không trùng với thiết bị nào khác; hay gặp: unique ID.
items.explanationEn: unique /juːˈniːk/ (adjective): unlike any other one. "A unique IP" is shared with no other device; see also unique ID.

items.question: Trong câu "Format: 192.168.1.100 — 4 groups of numbers, each from 0 to 255.", từ "format" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Format: 192.168.1.100 — 4 groups of numbers, each from 0 to 255.", what does "format" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: format /ˈfɔː.mæt/ (danh từ): định dạng. "Format" = định dạng, cách trình bày; động từ "format a disk" = định dạng ổ đĩa.
items.explanationEn: format /ˈfɔː.mæt/ (noun): the way data is arranged. "Format" is how data is laid out; as a verb, "format a disk" means prepare it.

items.question: Trong câu "Total: ~4.3 billion addresses (nearly exhausted).", từ "exhausted" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Total: ~4.3 billion addresses (nearly exhausted).", what does "exhausted" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: exhausted /ɪɡˈzɔː.stɪd/ (tính từ): cạn kiệt, dùng hết. "Nearly exhausted" = gần cạn kiệt (IPv4 sắp hết); nghĩa khác: kiệt sức (I'm exhausted).
items.explanationEn: exhausted /ɪɡˈzɔː.stɪd/ (adjective): completely used up. "Nearly exhausted" means almost used up (IPv4 is running out); another sense is extremely tired.

items.question: Trong câu "Total: ~4.3 billion addresses (nearly exhausted).", từ "nearly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Total: ~4.3 billion addresses (nearly exhausted).", what does "nearly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: nearly /ˈnɪə.li/ (trạng từ): gần như. "Nearly" = gần như, suýt; đừng nhầm với "near" (gần về khoảng cách) hay "recently".
items.explanationEn: nearly /ˈnɪə.li/ (adverb): almost. "Nearly" means almost; do not confuse it with near (distance) or recently.

items.question: Trong câu "Format: 2001:0db8:85a3:0000:0000:8a2e:0370:7334 — 8 groups of hexadecimal.", từ "hexadecimal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Format: 2001:0db8:85a3:0000:0000:8a2e:0370:7334 — 8 groups of hexadecimal.", what does "hexadecimal" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hexadecimal /ˌhek.səˈdes.ɪ.məl/ (danh từ): hệ thập lục phân (cơ số 16). "Hexadecimal" (hex) dùng chữ số 0–9 và a–f; IPv6 và mã màu (#ff0000) viết bằng hex.
items.explanationEn: hexadecimal /ˌhek.səˈdes.ɪ.məl/ (noun): the base-16 number system. Hexadecimal (hex) uses 0–9 and a–f; IPv6 addresses and colour codes like #ff0000 use it.

items.question: Trong câu "Total: 340 undecillion addresses (effectively unlimited for now).", từ "effectively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Total: 340 undecillion addresses (effectively unlimited for now).", what does "effectively" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: effectively /ɪˈfek.tɪv.li/ (trạng từ): trên thực tế, xem như. "Effectively unlimited" = xem như vô hạn; nghĩa khác: một cách hiệu quả (work effectively).
items.explanationEn: effectively /ɪˈfek.tɪv.li/ (adverb): in practice, virtually. "Effectively unlimited" means unlimited for all practical purposes; another sense is successfully.

items.question: Trong câu "Total: 340 undecillion addresses (effectively unlimited for now).", từ "unlimited" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Total: 340 undecillion addresses (effectively unlimited for now).", what does "unlimited" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unlimited /ʌnˈlɪm.ɪ.tɪd/ (tính từ): không giới hạn. "Unlimited" = không giới hạn; tiền tố "un-" mang nghĩa phủ định.
items.explanationEn: unlimited /ʌnˈlɪm.ɪ.tɪd/ (adjective): without any limit. "Unlimited" means with no limit; the prefix un- makes it negative.

items.question: Trong câu "Total: 340 undecillion addresses (effectively unlimited for now).", từ "for now" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Total: 340 undecillion addresses (effectively unlimited for now).", what does "for now" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: for now /fər ˈnaʊ/ (cụm từ): trong hiện tại, tạm thời. "For now" = hiện tại thì vậy, có thể thay đổi sau; đồng nghĩa: for the time being.
items.explanationEn: for now /fər ˈnaʊ/ (phrase): at the present time. "For now" means at present, possibly changing later; similar to for the time being.

items.question: Trong câu "Private: used only within the internal network.", từ "internal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Private: used only within the internal network.", what does "internal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: internal /ɪnˈtɜː.nəl/ (tính từ): nội bộ. "Internal network" = mạng nội bộ (LAN); trái nghĩa: external.
items.explanationEn: internal /ɪnˈtɜː.nəl/ (adjective): inside an organisation. "Internal network" is a private local network; the opposite is external.

items.question: Trong câu "Public: an address on the Internet, unique worldwide.", từ "worldwide" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Public: an address on the Internet, unique worldwide.", what does "worldwide" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: worldwide /ˌwɜːldˈwaɪd/ (trạng từ): trên toàn thế giới. "Unique worldwide" = không trùng trên toàn thế giới; đồng nghĩa: globally.
items.explanationEn: worldwide /ˌwɜːldˈwaɪd/ (adverb): across the whole world. "Unique worldwide" means no duplicate anywhere in the world; synonym: globally.

items.question: Trong câu "Hosting is a service that rents out space on a server to store a website.", từ "rent out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hosting is a service that rents out space on a server to store a website.", what does "rent out" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to let others use for payment
items.explanation: rent out /rent ˈaʊt/ (cụm từ): cho thuê. "Rent out X" = cho người khác thuê X; "rent X" có thể là đi thuê X.
items.explanationEn: rent out /rent ˈaʊt/ (phrase): to let others use for payment. "Rent out X" means let others pay to use X; "rent X" often means pay to use it.

items.question: Trong câu "Hosting is a service that rents out space on a server to store a website.", từ "space" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hosting is a service that rents out space on a server to store a website.", what does "space" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: space /speɪs/ (danh từ): dung lượng lưu trữ. "Space on a server" = dung lượng trên máy chủ; nghĩa khác: vũ trụ, phím cách (space bar).
items.explanationEn: space /speɪs/ (noun): room for storing data. "Space on a server" is storage room; other senses: outer space, the space bar character.

items.question: Trong câu "Hosting is a service that rents out space on a server to store a website.", từ "store" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hosting is a service that rents out space on a server to store a website.", what does "store" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: store /stɔːr/ (động từ): lưu trữ. "Store a website" = lưu trữ website; danh từ "store" = cửa hàng; "storage" = kho lưu trữ.
items.explanationEn: store /stɔːr/ (verb): to keep for later use. "Store a website" means keep its files; as a noun, a store is a shop; storage is the related noun.

items.question: Trong câu "Many websites share a single server", từ "share" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many websites share a single server", what does "share" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: share /ʃeər/ (động từ): dùng chung. "Share a server" = dùng chung một máy chủ; hay gặp: shared hosting; nghĩa khác: cổ phần.
items.explanationEn: share /ʃeər/ (verb): to use together. "Share a server" means use it together; see shared hosting; as a noun, a share is a stake in a company.

items.question: Trong câu "Renting an entire physical machine", từ "entire" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Renting an entire physical machine", what does "entire" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: entire /ɪnˈtaɪər/ (tính từ): toàn bộ. "An entire machine" = cả một máy; trạng từ: entirely (hoàn toàn).
items.explanationEn: entire /ɪnˈtaɪər/ (adjective): whole, complete. "An entire machine" means the whole machine; adverb: entirely.

items.question: Trong câu "Private: used only within the internal network.", từ "within" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Private: used only within the internal network.", what does "within" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: within /wɪˈðɪn/ (giới từ): bên trong, trong phạm vi. "Within the network" = trong phạm vi mạng; cũng dùng cho thời gian: within minutes.
items.explanationEn: within /wɪˈðɪn/ (preposition): inside the limits of. "Within the network" means inside its limits; also for time: within minutes.

items.question: Trong câu "Static IP: does not change — used for servers that a domain needs to point to.", từ "static" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Static IP: does not change — used for servers that a domain needs to point to.", what does "static" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: static /ˈstæt.ɪk/ (tính từ): cố định, không đổi. "Static IP" = IP tĩnh, không đổi; nghĩa khác: tĩnh điện (static electricity).
items.explanationEn: static /ˈstæt.ɪk/ (adjective): not changing. "Static IP" is an address that never changes; another sense is static electricity.

items.question: Trong câu "Static IP: does not change — used for servers that a domain needs to point to.", từ "point to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Static IP: does not change — used for servers that a domain needs to point to.", what does "point to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: point to /pɔɪnt tuː/ (cụm từ): trỏ tới. "A domain points to a server" = tên miền trỏ tới IP máy chủ (qua bản ghi DNS).
items.explanationEn: point to /pɔɪnt tuː/ (phrase): to direct toward. "A domain points to a server" means it directs traffic to that IP via DNS.

items.question: Trong câu "Static IP: does not change — used for servers that a domain needs to point to.", từ "domain" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Static IP: does not change — used for servers that a domain needs to point to.", what does "domain" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: domain /dəˈmeɪn/ (danh từ): tên miền. Ở đây "domain" = tên miền; nghĩa khác: lĩnh vực (domain knowledge), lãnh thổ.
items.explanationEn: domain /dəˈmeɪn/ (noun): a website name. Here domain is a website name; other senses: a field (domain knowledge) or a territory.

items.question: Trong câu "Static IP: does not change — used for servers that a domain needs to point to.", từ "server" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Static IP: does not change — used for servers that a domain needs to point to.", what does "server" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: server /ˈsɜː.vər/ (danh từ): máy chủ. "Server" trong IT = máy chủ; nghĩa đời thường: người phục vụ; động từ gốc: serve.
items.explanationEn: server /ˈsɜː.vər/ (noun): a computer serving requests. In IT a server answers requests; in everyday use it is someone who waits tables; verb: serve.

items.question: Trong câu "Dynamic IP: changes on each connection — used for ordinary user devices.", từ "dynamic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dynamic IP: changes on each connection — used for ordinary user devices.", what does "dynamic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: dynamic /daɪˈnæm.ɪk/ (tính từ): thay đổi, động. "Dynamic IP" = IP động, đổi theo phiên; nghĩa khác: năng động (a dynamic person).
items.explanationEn: dynamic /daɪˈnæm.ɪk/ (adjective): changing over time. "Dynamic IP" changes over time; another sense is energetic (a dynamic person).

items.question: Trong câu "Dynamic IP: changes on each connection — used for ordinary user devices.", từ "connection" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dynamic IP: changes on each connection — used for ordinary user devices.", what does "connection" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: connection /kəˈnek.ʃən/ (danh từ): lần kết nối (mạng). "On each connection" = mỗi lần kết nối; nghĩa khác: mối quan hệ, chuyến nối (miss a connection).
items.explanationEn: connection /kəˈnek.ʃən/ (noun): a link to a network. "On each connection" means every time you connect; other senses: a contact, a transfer flight.

items.question: Trong câu "Dynamic IP: changes on each connection — used for ordinary user devices.", từ "ordinary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dynamic IP: changes on each connection — used for ordinary user devices.", what does "ordinary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ordinary /ˈɔː.dən.ər.i/ (tính từ): thông thường, bình thường. "Ordinary user devices" = thiết bị người dùng thông thường; trái nghĩa: extraordinary.
items.explanationEn: ordinary /ˈɔː.dən.ər.i/ (adjective): normal, not special. "Ordinary user devices" are normal consumer devices; the opposite is extraordinary.

items.question: Trong câu "Dynamic IP: changes on each connection — used for ordinary user devices.", từ "device" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dynamic IP: changes on each connection — used for ordinary user devices.", what does "device" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: device /dɪˈvaɪs/ (danh từ): thiết bị. "User devices" = thiết bị của người dùng (điện thoại, laptop); hay gặp: mobile device.
items.explanationEn: device /dɪˈvaɪs/ (noun): a piece of equipment. "User devices" are phones and laptops people use; see also mobile device.

items.question: Trong câu "VPS: a private virtual server — a balance between cost and flexibility.", từ "virtual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "VPS: a private virtual server — a balance between cost and flexibility.", what does "virtual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: virtual /ˈvɜː.tʃu.əl/ (tính từ): ảo (mô phỏng bằng phần mềm). "Virtual server" = máy chủ ảo chạy trên phần cứng chung; nghĩa khác: gần như (virtually impossible).
items.explanationEn: virtual /ˈvɜː.tʃu.əl/ (adjective): simulated by software. "Virtual server" is simulated on shared hardware; another sense is almost (virtually impossible).

items.question: Trong câu "VPS: a private virtual server — a balance between cost and flexibility.", từ "balance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "VPS: a private virtual server — a balance between cost and flexibility.", what does "balance" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an even mix of two things
items.explanation: balance /ˈbæl.əns/ (danh từ): sự cân bằng. "A balance between A and B" = sự cân bằng giữa A và B; nghĩa khác: số dư (account balance).
items.explanationEn: balance /ˈbæl.əns/ (noun): an even mix of two things. "A balance between A and B" is an even mix; another sense is an account balance.

items.question: Trong câu "VPS: a private virtual server — a balance between cost and flexibility.", từ "cost" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "VPS: a private virtual server — a balance between cost and flexibility.", what does "cost" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: cost /kɒst/ (danh từ): chi phí. "Cost" = chi phí; hay gặp: cost-effective (tiết kiệm chi phí), low cost.
items.explanationEn: cost /kɒst/ (noun): the price you pay. "Cost" is what you must pay; see cost-effective, low cost.

items.question: Trong câu "VPS: a private virtual server — a balance between cost and flexibility.", từ "flexibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "VPS: a private virtual server — a balance between cost and flexibility.", what does "flexibility" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: flexibility /ˌflek.səˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): sự linh hoạt. "Flexibility" = tính linh hoạt, dễ thay đổi theo nhu cầu; tính từ: flexible.
items.explanationEn: flexibility /ˌflek.səˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): ease of adapting. "Flexibility" is the ability to adapt to needs; adjective: flexible.

items.question: Trong câu "Web Hosting: a service for storing a website on a server.", từ "store" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Web Hosting: a service for storing a website on a server.", what does "store" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: store /stɔːr/ (động từ): lưu trữ. "Storing a website" = lưu trữ website; danh từ liên quan: storage.
items.explanationEn: store /stɔːr/ (verb): to keep safely. "Storing a website" means keeping its files; related noun: storage.
